collection.title: Bentley Continental Convertible 2018 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Bentley Continental Convertible 2018 to 2024 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 24" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
